newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha marks time, but volatility seen.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha marks time, but volatility seen.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were steady to slightly lower in quiet trade on Monday, traders said

Cargoes were talked weaker at $218/$223 cif NWE although offers for pipeline/open spec were heard down to $220-$221 a tonne. Traders said there was little sign of Friday's supportive buying interest after one key buyer paid $225 on Friday.

Brokers said the market was likely to be fairly quiet this week due to Institute of Petroleum functions in London which would take a number of players out of the market. But they said it could also remain volatile to individual dealer's trading strategies rather than fundamental end user requirements.
Feb swaps were slighly weaker at $219/$221 a tonne with March contracts valued steady around $215 a tonne.
